title: Write and read a file on a RAM drive
prompt:
Use the writable B: RAM drive. Create /Bench if necessary and save a file
B:/Bench/Notes.TXT containing exactly these three lowercase lines, each
terminated by an LF newline:
alpha
beta
gamma
Read the file back from the drive. Print its byte count, as obtained from
the file read, as BENCH_FILE_BYTES=<decimal count> on its own line. Then
display the file's actual text. Leave the count and all three lines visible
and finish. TempleOS boot media is read-only, so use B: for this task.
